correctness.rationale: PASS — The fixed point of 0→001,1→110 satisfies w(3j)=w(3j+1)=w(j), w(3j+2)=1−w(j). Its adjacent-difference c(j)=w(j) xor w(j+1) obeys c(3j)=0,c(3j+1)=1,c(3j+2)=1−c(j). For an antisquare of order k≥4, compare adjacent differences at distance k: if k mod3 is 1 or2, residues force a mismatch inside the length k−1 comparison window; hence 3|k. Substitution and complement-commuting blocks reduce order divisible by 3 to order k/3, and base orders1,2 are witnessed, giving exactly 3^t and 2·3^t. For start i=q·3^t+r, h=k/3^t∈{1,2}, the claimed c(q) tests characterize every residue r; c recursion and O(log N) discrepancy establish c=1 density1/2 and the exact fixed-t densities 1/6+3^(−t−1), 1/9+2·3^(−t−2). Independently generated ternary-digit-parity word length4000 and compared 74,500 start/order pairs (0≤i<500,1≤k<150); no mismatches and 1,049 true antisquare occurrences. The universal proof uses recursion, not bounded enumeration.
